option_a: w-1 Officetel Security Guard Testimony Lead
option_b: w-1 Officetel Security Guard Witness Line

source_ko: 숨김의 시작과 실제 송금 실행의 순서는 서로 다르다.
target_text: The start of the concealment and the actual execution of the transfer happen in a different order.
option_a: The concealment began at a different point than the actual transfer.
option_b: The order of concealment and the actual transfer do not match.
notes: duo.relationshipLedger[3].description; awkward agreement and phrasing obscure the intended timing contrast.

source_ko: 블랙박스를 확인해 보고, 매일 같은 오피스텔에 두세 시간씩 방문하는 것을 알게 되었습니다. 네비 즐겨찾기에는 그 주소가 저장돼 있었습니다.
target_text: I checked the dashcam and found that he was visiting the same studio apartment every day for two or three hours at a time. The address was saved in his GPS bookmarks.
option_a: I checked the dashcam and found that he was visiting the same Officetel every day for two or three hours at a time. The address was saved in his GPS favorites.
option_b: When I checked the dashcam, I learned he was spending two or three hours at the same Officetel every day. The address was saved in the navigation favorites.
notes: dialogues[2].text; glossary locks 오피스텔 as Officetel, not studio apartment.

source_ko: 조건부 조정이라면 저도 받아들이겠습니다. 다만 오피스텔 방문과 새벽 전화의 사실관계부터 먼저 분명히 정리되어야 같은 의심이 반복되지 않습니다.
target_text: If it is a conditional mediation, I can accept that. But the facts about the studio-apartment visits and the late-night calls have to be settled clearly first, or the same suspicion just keeps coming back.
option_a: If this is conditional mediation, I can accept that. But the facts about the Officetel visits and early-morning calls need to be clarified first, or the same suspicion will keep coming back.
option_b: I can accept conditional mediation, but the Officetel visits and early-morning calls must be sorted out clearly first so the same suspicion does not repeat.
notes: paths.conditional.dialogues[0].text; Officetel term drift plus late-night weakens 새벽.

source_ko: 저도 해결책보다 사실 정리가 먼저라면 받아들이겠습니다. 다만 오피스텔 방문과 새벽 전화가 곧 외도라는 식으로 굳어지지는 않게 해 주시기 바랍니다.
target_text: If facts come before solutions, I can accept that. But please don't let the studio-apartment visits and late-night calls calcify into a finding of an affair.
option_a: If we are sorting out the facts before discussing a solution, I can accept that. But please do not let the Officetel visits and early-morning calls harden into a finding of an affair.
option_b: I can accept putting facts first, but please do not treat the Officetel visits and early-morning calls as proof of an affair.
notes: paths.fact_first.dialogues[1].text; "calcify" is unnatural in this dialogue and Officetel terminology is inconsistent.

source_ko: 방문·통화 경위
target_text: Reason for Hiding
option_a: Visit and Call Circumstances
option_b: Circumstances of the Visits and Calls
notes: angles[0].label; EN shifts from visit/call circumstances to motive for concealment.

source_ko: 오피스텔 방문, 새벽 전화, 영수증 물건을 같은 의심선상에서 확인한다.
target_text: Confirm why the visits, calls, and items were not explained to the spouse.
option_a: Review the Officetel visits, early-morning calls, and receipt items along the same line of suspicion.
option_b: Check the Officetel visits, early-morning calls, and receipt items together as part of the same suspicion.
notes: angles[0].description; KO asks to verify evidence on one suspicion line, not why it was hidden.

source_ko: 오피스텔 방문 동선
target_text: Studio-Apartment Visit Route
option_a: Officetel Visit Route
option_b: Route of the Officetel Visits
notes: angles[1].label; glossary locks 오피스텔 as Officetel.

source_ko: 오피스텔, 전화, 물건이 외도 정황인지 아닌지를 구분한다.
target_text: Distinguish whether the studio apartment, the calls, and the items truly point to an affair.
option_a: Distinguish whether the Officetel, the calls, and the items point to an affair.
option_b: Separate whether the Officetel visits, calls, and items are actually signs of an affair.
notes: angles[4].description; Officetel term drift.

source_ko: 목돈 출금 경위
target_text: Spouse Consent Excluded
option_a: Large Withdrawal Circumstances
option_b: Circumstances of the Large Cash Withdrawal
notes: angles[6].label; EN names a different sub-issue instead of the withdrawal circumstances.

source_ko: 적금·송금 경위
target_text: Loss and Legal Responsibility
option_a: Savings Cancellation and Transfer Circumstances
option_b: How the Savings and Transfer Happened
notes: angles[11].label; EN jumps to legal responsibility/loss, which is covered by a later angle.

source_ko: 영수증, 통화기록, 방문 시간 가운데 지금 자리에서 인정하는 항목과 아직 다투고 싶은 항목을 구분해 말씀해 주십시오.
target_text: Please organize what can be confirmed from records, without filling the gaps with interpretation.
option_a: Please separate the receipts, call logs, and visit times into what you acknowledge here and what you still wish to dispute.
option_b: Tell us which receipt, call-log, and visit-time items you accept now and which you still contest.
notes: judgeQuestions[0].variants[3].text; EN drops the admit-vs-dispute structure and concrete evidence list.

source_ko: 오피스텔 방문 기록, 새벽 통화 내역, 영수증 가운데 본인 손으로 직접 확인한 항목은 무엇입니까. 추정으로 이어진 부분과 분리해 답해 주십시오.
target_text: Please separate the parts you directly confirmed from the parts that remained inference.
option_a: Which Officetel visit records, early-morning call details, and receipts did you personally verify? Please separate those from the parts that remained inference.
option_b: Among the Officetel visits, early-morning calls, and receipts, identify what you checked yourself and what you only inferred.
notes: judgeQuestions[1].variants[1].text; concrete evidence anchors are lost.

source_ko: 오피스텔 출입과 새벽 통화, 차 안 영수증이 모두 본인 쪽에서 비롯된 일이라는 점은 맞습니까. 그 가운데 외도와 무관하다고 보는 근거를 시간순으로 정리해 주십시오.
target_text: Please separate what you personally did from what you only learned afterward or do not remember.
option_a: Do you agree that the Officetel entries, early-morning calls, and receipts in the car all came from your side? Please lay out, in order, why you say they were unrelated to an affair.
option_b: First confirm whether the Officetel visits, early-morning calls, and car receipts were your actions, then explain chronologically why they were not about an affair.
notes: judgeQuestions[24].variants[1].text; generic template loses the core affair-denial question.

source_ko: 공동 적금 계좌와 개인 계좌가 따로 있었다면 두 계좌의 잔액 변동을 각각 시간순으로 답해 주십시오.
target_text: Please separate what you personally did from what you only learned afterward or do not remember.
option_a: If the joint savings account and the personal account were separate, please explain the balance changes in each account in chronological order.
option_b: Please lay out, separately and in order, how the balances changed in the joint savings account and the personal account.
notes: judgeQuestions[48].variants[1].text; account-balance timeline is replaced by an unrelated generic prompt.

source_ko: 해지 신청, 서류 제출, 수령 계좌, 송금 가운데 본인이 직접 처리한 단계와 다른 사람에게 맡긴 단계를 시간순으로 정리해 주십시오.
target_text: Please separate the parts you directly confirmed from the parts that remained inference.
option_a: Please lay out, in order, which steps you handled yourself and which you left to someone else: the cancellation request, document submission, receiving account, and transfer.
option_b: For the cancellation request, submitted documents, receiving account, and transfer, separate what you did yourself from what someone else handled.
notes: judgeQuestions[66].variants[1].text; procedural steps and agency distinction are lost.

source_ko: 이준호 씨, 4개월 전 현금 출금 시점과 박지연 씨의 적금 해지·송금 시점을 본인이 아는 한 시간순으로 답해 주십시오.
target_text: Mr. Lee Jun-ho, please state the facts about your cash withdrawal four months ago and the silence that followed in chronological order.
option_a: Mr. Lee Jun-ho, as far as you know, please state in chronological order the timing of your cash withdrawal four months ago and Ms. Park Ji-yeon's savings cancellation and transfer.
option_b: Mr. Lee Jun-ho, please line up the timing of your cash withdrawal four months ago with Ms. Park Ji-yeon's cancellation and transfer of the savings account.
notes: judgeQuestions[115].variants[0].text; EN omits Park Ji-yeon’s cancellation/transfer and adds silence.

source_ko: 박지연 씨, 계좌 확인, 위임 서류 처리, 송금, 손실까지 네 단계로 나누어 본인이 한 일을 시간순으로 답해 주십시오.
target_text: Ms. Park Ji-yeon, please answer first when and through which material you confirmed separating your own responsibility from comparison.
option_a: Ms. Park Ji-yeon, please divide what you did into four steps-account checking, handling the authorization documents, the transfer, and the loss-and explain them in chronological order.
option_b: Ms. Park Ji-yeon, please state, in order, your own actions in the account check, authorization paperwork, transfer, and resulting loss.
notes: judgeQuestions[126].variants[0].text; EN is semantically broken and drops all four required steps.

source_ko: 이준호 씨, 침묵이 시작된 시점, 박지연 씨의 계좌 확인을 알게 된 시점, 본인이 현금을 움직인 시점, 박지연 씨가 적금을 움직인 시점을 각각 한 줄씩 시간순으로 답해 주십시오.
target_text: Mr. Lee Jun-ho, please state the facts about separating your own responsibility from comparison in chronological order.
option_a: Mr. Lee Jun-ho, please answer in chronological order, one line each: when your silence began, when you learned Ms. Park was checking the account, when you moved the cash, and when Ms. Park moved the savings.
option_b: Mr. Lee Jun-ho, line up four points: the start of your silence, your awareness of Ms. Park's account checking, your cash movement, and Ms. Park's savings movement.
notes: judgeQuestions[127].variants[0].text; EN generic/nonsensical template loses the requested four-point chronology.

source_ko: 박지연 씨, 침묵의 선후를 지금 결론짓자는 뜻은 아닙니다. 상대 침묵을 본인이 처음 알아챈 한 시점만이라도 다시 짚어 주실 수 있겠습니까.
target_text: Ms. Park Ji-yeon, this is not meant to settle the order of silence now. Could you revisit even one moment when you first noticed the other side's silence?
option_a: Ms. Park Ji-yeon, I am not asking you to decide who stayed silent first. Could you revisit just one moment when you first noticed the other side was holding something back?
option_b: Ms. Park Ji-yeon, this is not about settling who was silent first. Please return to one moment when you first sensed the other side's silence.
notes: judgeQuestions[106].variants[4].text; "order of silence" is a literal noun phrase flagged by V01.

source_ko: 박지연 씨, 계좌를 먼저 확인하기 시작한 시점과 공동 적금을 해지한 시점을 구분해 말씀해 주십시오.
target_text: Ms. Park, please separate what you saw, did, and assumed, and set out the chronology of the order of concealment, monitoring, execution, and manipulation.
option_a: Ms. Park, please separate when you first began checking the account from when you cancelled the joint savings account.
option_b: Ms. Park, tell us separately when you began looking at the account and when the joint savings account was cancelled.
notes: channels.judge_question.entries[36].variants[1].text; generic template replaces the specific two-timepoint question.

source_ko: 박지연 씨, 먼저 배신당했다는 감정이 해지 절차 문제의 책임을 없애지는 못합니다. 왜 두 문제를 하나로 묶으셨습니까.
target_text: Ms. Park, your statements on the order of concealment, monitoring, execution, and manipulation no longer line up. Separate the missing facts from the interpretation and answer plainly.
option_a: Ms. Park, feeling betrayed first does not remove your responsibility for the cancellation procedure. Why did you treat those two issues as one?
option_b: Ms. Park, being hurt first does not erase the issue with the cancellation process. Explain why you combined the two.
notes: channels.judge_contradiction.entries[10].variants[1].text; EN loses betrayal/procedure-responsibility contrast.

source_ko: 제가 확인한 건 맞습니다. 같은 주소가 반복돼서 외도 동선으로 봤습니다.
target_text: Your Honor, the dashcam GPS led to the same studio apartment address again and again. I admit my reading may have been colored by fear, but the records themselves are not made up. The act in the record was on my husband's side, not mine.
option_a: I did check it myself. The same Officetel address kept repeating, so I read it as an affair route.
option_b: Yes, I verified it. Because the same Officetel address appeared repeatedly, I understood it as the route of an affair.
notes: channels.evidence_present.entries[63].variants[0].text; EN adds defensive claims not in KO and uses studio apartment.

source_ko: 네. 혼자 말씀드리면 더 피하지 않겠습니다. 저는 동선만 본 게 아니라 돈 움직임까지 붙들고 있었습니다.
target_text: Now that we are alone, Your Honor — I admit I was the one who moved money first, even before the truth was clear. Even in this protected setting, I am putting this on record as truth.
option_a: Yes. If I am speaking to you alone, I will stop avoiding it. I was not only tracking his route; I was also holding on to the movement of money.
option_b: Yes. Since this is private, I will not dodge it: I was watching not just the route but the money movement as well.
notes: channels.trust_action.entries[2].variants[0].text; EN overstates a confession of first money movement that KO does not directly make.

source_ko: 이준호 씨, 차가 간 곳과 문자 속 그 개인적인 일정이 같은 생활권을 가리킵니다. 그곳에 있던 사람을 더 미룰 수 없습니다.
target_text: Mr. Lee, the submitted evidence narrow the issue to the hidden family circumstances behind the Officetel visits and calls. Please explain the point clearly.
option_a: Mr. Lee, where the car went and the personal schedule in the text point to the same area of daily life. You can no longer put off saying who was there.
option_b: Mr. Lee, the car route and the personal schedule in the text point to the same place. Please explain who was there.
notes: channels.judge_evidence_combo.entries[1].variants[1].text; subject-verb agreement error plus generic phrasing.

source_ko: 투자방 링크는 제가 보냈습니다. 사기인 줄 몰랐지만, 지연 씨를 그 방으로 보낸 건 저입니다.
target_text: I sent the investment chat link. I did not know it was a scam, but I was the one who sent Ji-yeon into that room.
option_a: I sent the investment chat link. I did not know it was a scam, but I was the one who led Ji-yeon to that chat room.
option_b: I sent the link to the investment chat. I did not know it was a scam, but I was the one who got Ji-yeon into that room.
notes: channels.witness.entries[8].variants[0].text; "sent Ji-yeon into that room" is unnatural in witness testimony.
